theorems.name: Submission.iwl_rl_monotone_helly_selection
theorems.statement: ∀ (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (C : ℝ), (∀ j, Monotone (F j)) → (∀ j t, |F j t| ≤ C) → ∃ (ψ : ℕ → ℕ) (E : Set ℝ), StrictMono ψ ∧ E.Countable ∧ ∀ s ∉ E, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ a b : ℝ, a < s ∧ s < b ∧ ∀ᶠ j in atTop, F (ψ j) b - F (ψ j) a < ε
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
